title: Implement the first news ingestion path

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Parser tests cover the source format.
Raw payloads are stored before normalization.
Normalized records are persisted with source and timestamps.
The first page can search the ingested records.
The path works without private credentials.
A fresh run ingests the source.
The first page returns the ingested records.
The repository is tagged and backed up.
